news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹6.04 loss per share (down from ₹2.27 profit in 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹181.0k (down 366% from profit in 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 53% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 24% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.
